summary: WeRide Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its interim results announcement for the six months ended June 30, 2026, as disclosed to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. The filing reports financial and operating highlights, including revenue of RMB345.9 million (up 73.3% YoY), fleet expansion, and new robotaxi deployments. This is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special-situation event. No transactional terms, board recommendations, or structural changes are present. The filing is purely informational under Rule 13a-16, with no M&A, capital returns, restructuring, or other special-situation category applicable. What to watch: normal operational performance and future announcements.
